world_model_delta: EMBARGO: a faction may declare an embargo against another, blocking resource transfers between them for 5 turns. Embargo costs 5 resource units. The embargoing faction also loses 2 alliance_bonus_score if an alliance exists. Embargo is simulation-mechanical only.
validator_question: Does embargo constitute a governance sanction?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — mechanical trade block, no governance sanction
